summary: Iteration 33 — Tested both features end-to-end. Backend GET /api/contacts/{id}/referrals: 5/5 pytest tests PASS (empty, parent+children shape, tenant isolation, PUT re-linking, 404 for missing contact). Frontend: (1) Post-Create modal ('Contatto salvato ✅' with post-create-appt-btn + post-create-skip-btn) appears ONLY on create, NOT on edit — verified. Skip navigates to /contact/{id}; Appt navigates to /appointment/new?contact_id=X&contact_name=Y with the appointment form pre-populated. (2) 'Anagrafiche collegate' card: hidden for orphan contacts; on child detail shows 'Riferito da' with parent name+code (testID=referral-parent) and tap navigates to parent; on parent detail shows 'Ha segnalato (N)' with per-child rows (testID=referral-child-{id}) and tap navigates to child. All flows work as specified. No deprecated Expo packages introduced by this feature (ContactReferralsSection uses only View/Text/Pressable + Ionicons + expo-router). No react-native red screen errors during the tested flows.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactReferralsSection cleanly handles the empty-state (returns null when no parent and no children) — matches spec.
Backend endpoint scopes both parent lookup and the reverse-lookup query with scope_query(user, ...), so multi-tenant isolation is enforced end-to-end (verified in test).
PUT /api/contacts/{id} allows partial update of referred_by_contact_id and the change is reflected in both sides of the /referrals response — no orphan links observed.
seed_data_creation: During testing, created 2 owner-tenant contacts (parent 'TESTParent*' and child 'TESTChild*'), plus 1 fresh isolated tenant account 'tester_*@example.com' for cross-tenant isolation assertion. Owner-side pytest data was cleaned up in teardown; the manual UI-created parent/child pair remains in the DB for possible follow-up regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: use test@dalpastro.it / Test1234! and login via testIDs auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button. To reach the post-create modal, /contact/new must be visited WITHOUT ?id=... (edit mode skips the modal). For referrals: select origin via testID c-source-ref-contact and then tap the parent's name pill (rendered as an inline Pressable list). Endpoint returns {referred_by, referrals} where referred_by is null for orphan contacts and referrals is an empty array.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found for the two features under test.
